name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: Dark Iron attacks in the Wetlands have Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII fearing for the Stonewrought Dam. With much of its garrison sent to the Alliance Front, you investigate sappers near the eastern ramp.

sections.title: A Vulnerable Wonder
sections.body: The Stonewrought Dam holds back Loch Modan's waters, a great feat of Ironforge engineering. As conflicts spread across Khaz Modan and beyond, much of its security detail has been reassigned to the Alliance Front. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII and his small remaining crew now face the threat of an attack with little protection.

sections.title: Echoes from the North
sections.body: Dark Iron attacks in the Wetlands have given Hinderweir reason to worry. The dwarves struck the Thandol Span and pillaged the fortress town of Dun Modr. Now known Dark Iron sappers lurk near the dam's eastern ramp. Hinderweir fears the clan has turned its attention to the lifeline of Loch Modan.

sections.title: The Suspicious Cask
sections.body: A barrel lies among the rocks where the sappers gathered, packed with volatile powder that smells strange. Its presence points to preparations for demolitions against the Stonewrought Dam's foundation.

faq.q: Why is Chief Engineer Hinderweir worried about the dam?
faq.answer: Dark Iron forces struck the Thandol Span and pillaged Dun Modr in the Wetlands. When Hinderweir saw their sappers near the Stonewrought Dam's eastern ramp, he feared the dam was their next target.

faq.q: Where did the dam's garrison go?
aliases: why are there no guards at the dam
faq.answer: Most of the Stonewrought Dam's security forces were reassigned to the Alliance Front. Hinderweir's top inspector went with them, leaving the dam thinly defended.

faq.q: What do you find at the eastern ramp?
faq.answer: Near the eastern ramp, you find a suspicious barrel filled with strange-smelling powder. Its presence confirms the Dark Irons are preparing to sabotage the dam.

faq.q: What is the strategic significance of the Stonewrought Dam?
aliases: what happens if the dam breaks
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam controls Loch Modan's reservoir. If it breaks, the flood would devastate the Wetlands and drain the heart of dwarven territory.

faq.q: What was the attack on Dun Modr mentioned by Hinderweir?
faq.answer: Dun Modr was a fortified dwarven outpost in the northern Wetlands, near the Thandol Span. Dark Iron infiltrators overwhelmed the town and struck the span, cutting important overland supply routes.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Iron dwarves targeting Loch Modan?
aliases: why do dark irons hate ironforge
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan has long been bitter rivals of the Bronzebeard dwarves, ever since the War of the Three Hammers. From Blackrock Mountain and the Searing Gorge, they often sabotage Bronzebeard infrastructure and border defenses.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Stonewrought Dam as a masterwork of dwarven craft and pride. Dark Iron kin threaten it, making this defense of your homeland.
As an engineer, you can see the dam's immense scale and the danger of sappers using volatile chemical explosives against its load-bearing foundations.
As an Alliance recruit, you help guard vital supply hubs and regional works while frontline armies are spread thin across the continent.
